slides.heading: How long does an EV battery really last?
Most come with a long warranty
It fades slowly, it doesn't just die
Daily 20 to 80%, full only for trips

voice_lines: Most EVs in India come with a battery warranty of around eight years, often with a kilometre limit. Check your brand.
The battery fades slowly over the years. It doesn't just die one day.
What wears it faster: charging to a hundred percent every day, only using fast chargers, and parking in hot sun.
Keep daily charging between twenty and eighty percent, and charge full only before trips. Any doubts? Comment below or DM me on Instagram.
caption:
How long does an EV battery last? 🔋

• Most EVs in India come with a battery warranty of around 8 years, often with a km limit (check your brand's exact terms)
• Batteries fade slowly; they don't suddenly die

Wears it faster: 100% every day, only DC fast charging, parking in hot sun.

My rule: 20-80% daily, full charge only before long trips.

Any doubts? Comment below or DM me on Instagram 👇
